Here's a description of the provided plot, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between step count and accuracy for two experiments, labeled Ex1 and Ex2. The x-axis represents “Step”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, and tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis represents “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents Ex1 Accuracy, starting at a value of 0.10 at a step of 0 and increasing to approximately 0.41 at a step of 20000, then remaining relatively steady at approximately 0.41 until a step of 60000. A teal line, marked with circular data points, represents Ex2 Accuracy, beginning at a value of 0.24 at a step of 0, increasing to approximately 0.38 at a step of 20000, and then decreasing to approximately 0.33 at a step of 60000.
